brief_title: Egg Ingestion in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: Egg Ingestion in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes: Effects on Glycemic Control, Anthropometry, Diet Quality and Cardiometabolic Status A Randomized, Controlled, Crossover Trial
brief_summary: We propose a prospective, randomized, single-blind controlled crossover study to assess the effects of daily egg inclusion versus egg exclusion, on glycemic control, anthropometric measures, and overall diet quality in adults with Type 2 diabetes.

inclusion.text: post-menopausal females not currently on hormone replacement therapy;
clinical diagnosis of Type 2 diabetes mellitus for at least 1 year but no more than 5 years;

exclusion.text: anticipated inability to complete study protocol for any reason;
use of antihyperglycemic, lipid-lowering or antihypertensive medications unless stable on medication for at least 3 months;
use of glucocorticoids, antineoplastic agents, psychoactive agents, or nutraceuticals;
restricted diets (i.e., vegetarian, vegan, gluten free);
